Here is where every Ultimate Edition item and pre-order bonus shows up in GTA 6 during our test run.

Jason's Safehouse Vehicles Location

Available from Chapter 1 for owners of the Ultimate Edition.

You'll find the Dinka Enduro motorcycle around Jason's House in Key Lento, parked under the deck.

These items are only available in Chapter 1, so grab them before you leave the Keys.

'95 Grotti Cheetah Location

Available from Chapter 5 once the story reaches the city.

You'll get a notification and your '95 Grotti Cheetah will be parked in the basement of Pegassi Residences on Bayside Drive.

Vintage Vice City Pack Location

Your Vintage Vice City Pack pre-order bonus becomes available from Chapter 3.

Pick up your '55 Vapid Stanier parked outside a hotel in Vice Beach.
